# RevvMotiv

> Precision Automotive Aero & Carbon Fiber Styling Components for Drivers Across India.

RevvMotiv designs, sources, and installs 1:1 3D laser-scanned carbon fiber aero kits, spoilers, diffusers, custom tyre lettering, and performance lighting upgrades across India.

## Key Sections & Pages

- [Home](https://revvmotiv.com/): Featured builds, catalog categories, reels showcase, and customer reviews.
- [About Us](https://revvmotiv.com/about): Our engineering philosophy, 3D laser scanning fitment, pre-preg carbon fiber, and in-house fitting facility.
- [Our Work Showcase](https://revvmotiv.com/work): Real customer workshop builds documented across 14 view angles (Maruti Swift Full Aero Kit, Hyundai i20 N Line Blackout Package, Volkswagen Polo GT Track Look).
- [Store Catalog](https://revvmotiv.com/products): Complete store catalog for styling and performance parts.
- [Contact & Support](https://revvmotiv.com/contact): Customer consultant support, WhatsApp booking, and fitment enquiries.

## Primary Product Categories

- **Tyre Stickers**: 3D raised rubber permanent lettering kits (White, Red, Yellow, Silver Decals, Universal Kits).
- **Spoilers**: GT-Style rear wings, Carbon fiber trunk lips, Ducktail spoilers, Roof extensions, Adjustable wings with uprights.
- **Splitters & Side Skirts**: Twill carbon weave side skirts, ABS chin spoilers, V-style carbon front lips, Splitter winglets, Gloss black rocker panels.
- **Diffusers**: Quad-fin rear diffusers, Carbon fiber rear diffusers, Gloss black bumper diffusers, Dual-exit diffusers.
- **Batman Covers**: Bat-wing hood vent covers, Batman mirror covers, Fender vent trim, Bonnet scoops, Window louvers.
- **Lights & Flashers**: Smoked OLED sequential tail lights, LED DRL fog lamp kits, Sequential mirror indicators, Halo rings.
- **Car Audio & Utilities**: Component speaker upgrade kits, Subwoofer + Amp combos, Android Auto CarPlay head units, Dash cams.
- **Combos**: Front + Rear Aero Combo, Complete Lighting Upgrade Combo, Exterior Styling Starter Combo, Track Look Combo.

## Policies & Logistics

- [Shipping Policy](https://revvmotiv.com/policies/shipping-policy): Express nationwide shipping across 45+ Indian cities.
- [Refund & Return Policy](https://revvmotiv.com/policies/refund-policy): Fitment guarantee and 7-day hassle-free return support.
- [Contact Information](https://revvmotiv.com/policies/contact-information): Technical support & workshop fitment booking.
